validation.cycle.reason.eaf35a84: Legommenders operators form a directed acyclic pipeline.
validation.cycle.fix.fdd013c5: Remove the edge that closes the loop.
validation.duplicate_component.message.d: The model has more than one Item Encoder.
validation.duplicate_component.reason.4c: LegoConfig has a single optional item operator.
validation.duplicate_component.fix.425d4: Remove the extra Item Encoder node.
validation.duplicate_component.message.c: More than one objective block is present.
validation.duplicate_component.reason.6c: Only one training objective can drive config.use_neg_sampling.
validation.duplicate_component.fix.e33f9: Keep a single Matching/Ranking Task node.
validation.runtime_dimension.message.ff2: User and candidate embedding dimensions are resolved by LegoConfig at model build time.
validation.runtime_dimension.reason.ee82: The exact tensor shapes depend on the loaded UniTok data; they cannot be inferred from the graph alone.
validation.runtime_dimension.fix.9523394: Run the model-instantiation check (Generate Model → Verify) or start a real training run.
validation.model_identity.reason.26714af: Model identity is derived from the real component signature.
validation.model_identity.fix.320cb360: Review the generated YAML before citing a paper.
validation.dangling_edge.message.04079bd: An edge references a node that no longer exists.
validation.dangling_edge.fix.e13ba8a3: Delete the stale connection and reconnect the nodes.
validation.self_loop.message.c69cdf43: A node cannot be connected to itself.
validation.self_loop.reason.b75b3405: Legommenders components form a directed acyclic configuration graph.
validation.invalid_port.message.c4dffde4: An edge is attached to a port that does not exist.
validation.invalid_port.fix.d5b624e5: Reconnect using the ports declared by the component registry.
validation.port_type_mismatch.message.e7: Incompatible ports: `{{p0}}` outputs {{p1}}, but `{{p2}}` expects {{p3}} on `{{p4}}`.
validation.port_type_mismatch.reason.4a8: Port type {{p0}} is not accepted by an input of type {{p1}}.
validation.port_type_mismatch.fix.63422d: Connect a node producing one of: {{p0}}.
validation.duplicate_edge.reason.159ae78: The same output is wired twice into the same input.
validation.multiple_inputs.message.19817: Input `{{p0}}` of `{{p1}}` has more than one source.
validation.multiple_inputs.reason.4557ad: A required module input has exactly one upstream producer in Legommenders.
validation.multiple_inputs.fix.66d3f670: Keep a single incoming connection for this port.
validation.orphan_node.reason.c99f48f7: The node has no incoming or outgoing connections, so it cannot contribute to the model.
validation.orphan_node.fix.4a4e13e1: Connect it to the pipeline, or delete it from the canvas.
validation.missing_component.reason.fd01: LegoConfig always builds a user operator and a predictor; the data config is required too.
validation.missing_component.fix.4f04a19: Add one {{p0}} component from the library.
validation.task_incompatible.reason.883d: LegoConfig.build_components() rejects use_neg_sampling=True for predictors with allow_matching=False, and use_neg_sampling=False for predictors with allow_ranking=False.
validation.task_incompatible.fix.6ce625a: Switch the graph task, or replace the predictor with one that supports it.
validation.missing_input.message.ffa3e19: The predictor has no candidate item input.
validation.missing_input.reason.40c13e13: Matching scores B×(K+1) candidates; the connection documents that data flow.
validation.missing_input.fix.e7b12e3d: Connect the Item Encoder `candidate` output to the predictor.
validation.task_incompatible.message.e52: Objective `{{p0}}` requires a {{p1}} task, but the graph is {{p2}}.
validation.task_incompatible.reason.9758: config.use_neg_sampling and the loss selected in model/legommender.py would disagree.
validation.task_incompatible.fix.1582bf0: Set the graph task to {{p0}} or replace the objective node.
validation.dimension_mismatch.message.a1: Dimension Mismatch on `{{p0}}`: hidden_size={{p1}}, but the run uses {{p2}}.
validation.dimension_mismatch.reason.b9b: All Legommenders operators share one LegoConfig.hidden_size. `{{p0}}` would output {{p1}}-dimensional embeddings while the Dot predictor expects {{p2}}.
validation.dimension_mismatch.fix.84c6d9: Set `{{p0}}` hidden_size to {{p1}} (or change Hidden Size in Training settings).
validation.dimension_mismatch.fix.0e70ff: Change the number of heads or the input width.
validation.parameter_range.message.19ce7: IISAN projection sizes must match when both are set.
validation.runtime_dimension.reason.c03d: loader.manager.Manager feeds this output_dim into the user operator's input_dim.
validation.runtime_dimension.fix.a00036b: Confirm data.item.inputs column count at runtime.
validation.resource_required.reason.94e7: The operator reads pre-computed embeddings generated by embed.py.
validation.resource_required.fix.7cb01fd: Generate them with `python embed.py --model <name>` and select the matching embed_config.
validation.unknown_component.reason.ec04: It is not present in the dynamic Component Registry.
validation.unknown_component.fix.ab4c5f3: Delete the node and replace it with a registered component.
validation.external_hf_source.message.a5: Dataset external token resources need an Item Encoder.
validation.external_hf_source.fix.8cb427: Add an Item Encoder or select project token resources.
validation.unknown_parameter.reason.32dd: The component registry has no such configuration key; it will be ignored by the compiler.
validation.unknown_parameter.fix.6d7d21f: Remove the parameter or choose a component that declares it.
validation.parameter_choice.reason.f8e52: The component accepts a fixed set of values.
validation.missing_parameter.reason.23d5: This field is required to build a valid LegoConfig.
validation.missing_parameter.fix.528613a: Fill in `{{p0}}` in the Properties panel (default: {{p1}}).
validation.missing_input.reason.e356f659: The component cannot be instantiated without this upstream signal.
validation.missing_input.fix.b534f38f: Connect a node with a {{p0}} output to `{{p1}}`.
validation.duplicate_component.reason.db: Legommenders has exactly one slot for this module.
validation.data_config_missing.reason.05: The client may only reference server-controlled config files.
validation.data_config_missing.fix.81876: Choose a data_config from the Properties panel list.
validation.parameter_choice.fix.6ad877be: For example: ReLU, GELU, SiLU or Tanh.
validation.parameter_range.fix.960fab6b: Enter one value for all layers, or supply one value per layer.
